markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if certified election results are published.
markets.rules_primary: If the margin of victory for Seth Moulton in the 2026 Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary falls within 20% to 100%, inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The margin of victory shall be calculated as follows based on the margin type.

For percentage points: the vote percentage received by Seth Moulton minus the vote percentage received by the candidate/party/option that finishes immediately behind Seth Moulton if Seth Moulton wins, or the candidate/party that finishes first if Seth Moulton loses.
For raw votes: the total votes received by Seth Moulton minus the total votes received by the candidate/party/option that finishes immediately behind Seth Moulton if Seth Moulton wins, or the candidate/party/option that finishes first if Seth Moulton loses.
For electoral votes: the electoral votes received by Seth Moulton minus the electoral votes received by the candidate/party/option with the second-most electoral votes if Seth Moulton wins, or the electoral votes received by Seth Moulton minus the electoral votes received by the candidate/party/option with the most electoral votes if Seth Moulton does not.

Each margin range is inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound. No rounding shall be applied to the calculated margin. For example, for consecutive ranges of 5-6% and 6-7%, a margin of 5.99999% resolves within the 5-6% range, while a margin of exactly 6% resolves within the 6-7% range. If Seth Moulton runs under multiple parties or is listed multiple times, votes attributable to the same underlying natural Seth Moulton will be summed.

If Seth Moulton wins the election, the margin will be positive. If Seth Moulton loses the election, the margin will be negative. If Seth Moulton ties for first place, the margin shall be 0. For uncontested races where Seth Moulton is the only candidate, the margin shall be 100 percentage points or the total number of votes cast (for raw votes).
markets.title: Will the margin of victory for Seth Moulton in the 2026 Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary be above 20%?

markets.rules_primary: If the value of Nikkei 225 (NKY) is at least ¥80,000 from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the value of the Nikkei 225 as reported by the Trading View, using the index's natively published level in its own currency and units; no currency conversion is applied. It is sufficient for the index to reach or exceed ¥80,000 at any single point during from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026 for the market to resolve to Yes — the level does not need to be sustained. If the index does not reach ¥80,000 at any point during from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026, the market resolves to No. Revisions to the underlying made after expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value. 

If no data is available for from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026 by the Expiration Date, all strikes other than "No data" or "None" resolve to No. The index level is evaluated to two decimal places unless otherwise specified.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if any Quebec Professional Association of Real Estate Brokers monthly release shows a median price of single-family homes in the Montreal Census Metropolitan Area below C$625,000.
markets.rules_primary: If the the median price of single-family homes in the Montreal Census Metropolitan Area in 2026 is below C$625,000 in any Quebec Professional Association of Real Estate Brokers monthly release after Issuance and covering a month from Issuance through December 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the median price of single-family homes in the Montreal Census Metropolitan Area, based on Centris residential real estate broker data and reported by the Quebec Professional Association of Real Estate Brokers, also known as QPAREB or APCIQ. The market will not use average sale price, median price for condominiums, median price for plexes, all-property residential price, City of Montreal-only price, annual average price, or any other housing price measure.

Monthly releases covering periods before this market’s Issuance will not count toward resolution, even if they report an average residential sale price below C$625,000. The market will resolve based on the first published QPAREB/APCIQ figure for the relevant monthly release. Later revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution.
